svg.title: Independent trials with different success probabilities have unequal path weights
svg.desc: There are three independent trials with success probabilities one half, two thirds and three quarters. A table lists all eight success-failure paths. SSS has probability one quarter; SSF one twelfth; SFS one eighth; SFF one twenty-fourth; FSS one quarter; FSF one twelfth; FFS one eighth; FFF one twenty-fourth. Each row displays the product of the three position-specific success or failure probabilities. The exact-two paths SSF, SFS and FSS are highlighted in teal and have unequal weights, summing to eleven twenty-fourths. SSS is separately highlighted in orange because at least two successes includes it in addition to the exact-two paths. The at-least-two probability is seventeen twenty-fourths. All eight path weights sum to one.
